text:
Priya: quick ask — can we consolidate the 11:30 + 12:00 backend candidate into one 11:45 slot? Interviewers are tight today.
Samir: I can cover 11:45 if Elena can take scribe. @Elena?
Elena: I can scribe, but I need a 30m buffer after my previous. Also — do we want the scribe to use the new debrief form or continue with the old doc?
People Ops Bot: Reminder: please complete the candidate eval form within 24h after the panel. New debrief form is at https://intranet.redwood/debriefs/v2 (auto template).
Priya: use the new debrief form (link above). Important: mark the "format" field (takehome vs live). Also confirm rubric weights: technical 60%, behavioral 30%, culture 10% — still good?
Samir: yes that's the weights we agreed on last week. Small add: split technical into (algorithms 40%, system-design 30%, implementation 30%) — just so scribe can call out system design separately.
Elena: quick rubric question — if system design wasn't asked (time ran out), do we mark NA or give a low score? That will affect the panel average.
Jordan: Rule we've been using: if candidate wasn't given the chance, mark NA and add a short note. Ops will normalize NA values across panel during review. I'll ping analytics to confirm normalization window.
Priya: perfect. one more ops ask — can someone paste the candidate repo link here so scribe can reference snippets during debrief?
Samir: repo: https://git.internal/redwood/candidate-xyz. small snippet to highlight for scribe: ```diff
- def process(items):
-     return [x for x in items if x.valid()]
+ def process(items):
+     return [x for x in items if x.is_valid()]
```
Elena: got it. I'll bring the debrief form, mark the system-design slot, and note the 30m buffer. I'll also flag any question variants we used.
People Ops Bot: :white_check_mark: Panel slot updated: Candidate scheduled 11:45–12:15. Calendar invites sent. Please ensure timezone is recorded (PDT).
People Ops: Room booked in Zoom "Interview Room A" and calendar invites sent to panel + candidate. Let us know if you need recording enabled.
Priya: thanks everyone — I'll post the final slate 30m before and close this thread once invites are verified.
Elena: ack, will be ready.
Samir: thanks — see you then.
Jordan: noted — will follow up on normalization note separately.
